dialog.title: Connect {provider}
dialog.intro: Here is exactly what happens next, and what Markaestro will ask {provider} for.

0.title: Sign in on {host}
0.detail: You will be taken to {provider}'s own sign-in page. Markaestro never sees your password.

1.title: Review and Approve the Permissions
1.detail: {provider} lists the permissions below and asks you to allow them. Approve all of them so publishing and analytics both work.

2.title: Come Back to Markaestro
2.detail: You are returned here automatically and the account shows as Linked.

dialog.metaStepDetail: Facebook asks which Pages Markaestro may manage. Tick every Page you might post to; a Page left unticked loses access.
dialog.permissionsHint: Each permission is used only for the feature shown next to it.
dialog.reconnectNote: Reconnecting refreshes access. Accounts already linked to this brand stay linked.
dialog.privacyNote: You can disconnect at any time from this screen. Markaestro then deletes the access token it stored.

instagram.0: An Instagram Professional account (Business or Creator). Personal accounts cannot publish through Instagram's API.
instagram.1: The sign-in details for that Instagram account.

meta.0: A Facebook account with an Admin or Editor role on the Page you want to publish to.
meta.1: Tick every Page in Facebook's dialog, then pick the Page for this brand back in Markaestro.

threads.0: A Threads profile you can sign in to. Threads uses its own login, separate from Instagram.

tiktok.0: A TikTok account you can sign in to.
tiktok.1: Posts are delivered to your TikTok inbox and finished in the TikTok app.

x.0: An X account you can sign in to.
x.1: Your X developer access must allow post publishing and media uploads. Usage is subject to X API pricing and limits.

pinterest.0: A Pinterest business account with at least one board.
pinterest.1: After connecting, choose which board this brand pins to.

linkedin_profile.0: A LinkedIn account. Posts publish as you, on your personal profile.

linkedin_community.0: A LinkedIn account with an Admin role on the company Page you want to publish to.

instagram_business_basic.title: Basic Account Info
instagram_business_basic.description: Reads your Instagram username and account ID so Markaestro can show which account is linked and address posts to it.

instagram_business_content_publish.title: Publish Content
instagram_business_content_publish.description: Publishes the photos, videos and carousels you schedule in Markaestro to this Instagram account.

instagram_business_manage_insights.title: Read Insights
instagram_business_manage_insights.description: Reads reach, likes, comments, saves and follower counts to build the Analytics page.

pages_show_list.title: List Your Pages
pages_show_list.description: Lists the Facebook Pages you manage so you can choose which one this brand posts to.

pages_read_engagement.title: Read Page Engagement
pages_read_engagement.description: Reads the Page's name, follower count and post engagement for Analytics.

pages_manage_posts.title: Publish to the Page
pages_manage_posts.description: Creates the posts you schedule in Markaestro on the selected Facebook Page.

read_insights.title: Read Page Insights
read_insights.description: Reads reach and engagement insights for the Page and its posts.

pages_read_user_content.title: Read Page Content
pages_read_user_content.description: Reads posts and comments on the Page for the post history view.

threads_basic.title: Basic Profile
threads_basic.description: Reads your Threads username and profile picture so Markaestro can show which account is linked.

threads_content_publish.title: Publish Posts
threads_content_publish.description: Publishes the text, image and video posts you schedule in Markaestro to Threads.

threads_delete.title: Delete Posts
threads_delete.description: Deletes a Threads post when you remove it from the On platform tab in Markaestro.

threads_manage_insights.title: Read Insights
threads_manage_insights.description: Reads views, likes, replies and follower counts for Analytics.

user_info_basic.title: Basic Account Info
user_info_basic.description: Reads your TikTok display name and avatar so Markaestro can show which account is linked.

user_info_profile.title: Profile Details
user_info_profile.description: Reads your username, bio and profile link for the connected-account view.

video_publish.title: Publish Videos
video_publish.description: Sends the videos you schedule in Markaestro to your TikTok account.

video_upload.title: Upload Videos
video_upload.description: Uploads video files to TikTok so they can be published.

video_list.title: List Your Videos
video_list.description: Lists your published TikTok videos for the On platform tab and post metrics.

user_info_stats.title: Account Statistics
user_info_stats.description: Reads follower, like and video counts for Analytics.

user_accounts_read.title: Account Details
user_accounts_read.description: Reads your Pinterest username and profile so Markaestro can show which account is linked.

boards_read.title: Read Boards
boards_read.description: Lists your boards so you can choose which one this brand pins to.

boards_write.title: Manage Boards
boards_write.description: Required by Pinterest to create a pin, even on an existing board.

boards_read_secret.title: Read Secret Boards
boards_read_secret.description: Includes your secret boards in the board picker.

boards_write_secret.title: Pin to Secret Boards
boards_write_secret.description: Lets this brand pin to a secret board.

pins_read.title: Read Pins
pins_read.description: Reads your pins for the post history view.

pins_write.title: Create Pins
pins_write.description: Creates the pins you schedule in Markaestro.

pins_read_secret.title: Read Secret Pins
pins_read_secret.description: Reads pins on secret boards for the post history view.

openid.title: Sign in with LinkedIn
openid.description: Confirms which LinkedIn member is connecting.

profile.title: Basic Profile
profile.description: Reads your name and photo so Markaestro can show which profile is linked.

w_member_social.title: Post on Your Behalf
w_member_social.description: Publishes the posts you schedule in Markaestro to your LinkedIn profile.

r_member_postAnalytics.title: Read Post Analytics
r_member_postAnalytics.description: Reads impressions and engagement on your posts for Analytics.

r_member_profileAnalytics.title: Read Profile Analytics
r_member_profileAnalytics.description: Reads follower and profile-view counts for Analytics.

r_basicprofile.title: Basic Profile
r_basicprofile.description: Reads your name and photo so Markaestro can show who authorized the Pages.

w_organization_social.title: Post as the Page
w_organization_social.description: Publishes the posts you schedule in Markaestro to the company Page.

r_organization_social.title: Read Page Posts
r_organization_social.description: Reads the Page's posts for the post history view.

rw_organization_admin.title: List Pages You Administer
rw_organization_admin.description: Lists the company Pages you administer so you can choose which one this brand posts to.

tweet_read.title: Read Posts
tweet_read.description: Reads your posts and their public engagement for post history and performance measurement.

tweet_write.title: Publish Posts
tweet_write.description: Creates and deletes the posts you publish through Markaestro.

users_read.title: Read Account Identity
users_read.description: Reads your X account ID, username, name, and profile image so Markaestro can show the linked account.

media_write.title: Upload Media
media_write.description: Uploads images, GIFs, and videos attached to posts you publish through Markaestro.

offline_access.title: Stay connected
offline_access.description: Refreshes access so scheduled posts can publish when you are away.

outcome.successBodyNoAccount: The account is now linked to {brand}.
outcome.needsPageTitle: One More Step: Choose a Facebook Page
outcome.needsPageBody: Facebook access is granted. Now pick which Page this brand posts to.
outcome.needsBoardTitle: One More Step: Choose a Board
outcome.needsBoardBody: Pinterest access is granted. Now pick which board this brand pins to.

reasons.access_denied: You did not approve the permissions on {provider}, so nothing was linked. Start again and choose Allow to connect.
reasons.channel_limit: This brand has reached the number of channels your plan allows. Unlink a channel or upgrade, then try again.
reasons.connection_failed: {provider} did not complete the connection. Nothing was linked. Try again, and if it keeps failing check the requirements in the connection guide.

hints.connect: Opens {provider}'s sign-in page so you can approve access for this brand.
hints.reconnect: Runs {provider}'s sign-in again to refresh access. Linked accounts stay linked.
hints.disconnect: Removes this account from the brand and deletes the access token Markaestro stored.
hints.test: Sends one read-only request to {provider} to confirm the link still works.
hints.choosePages: Loads the Pages Facebook granted so you can pick which ones this brand posts to.
